t: Towns get painted props in the same style: the Stash is an iron-banded chest, the Crafting Bench a lectern with an open book, the Waystone a glowing stone circle, the Blacksmith works at an anvil on a stump, and the Merchant sells from a market tent with crates and barrels
Graves, trees, reeds, barrels, crates, stumps, braziers and chains around the towns are painted too (Settings > Props: Painted or Drawn)
Fixed: monsters, NPCs and wolves painted after Act 1 now show; the game no longer keeps an old list of painted art (it downloads the new art once)
Whirlwind: your hero keeps facing his way and swings while glowing blade trails sweep around him, with a swirl of air and dust flying off the edge
The Ranger's wolf is painted in the game's new style: it runs, bites and flinches; a Pack brings a black wolf alongside, and the Alpha is a big white wolf
Wolf art: "Wolf monsters animated" by Danimal, Micket and Poss (credits under How to play)
Towns: the Merchant and the Blacksmith are painted in the game's new style and turn to watch you
The town folk are painted too: men and women in peasant clothes, leather or robes in each town's colours, walking and stopping to talk
Lighting: you and the monsters are lit up to your heads by the light you stand in, instead of fading into the dark above the feet
Figures take a little of the light's colour: warm by torches, cold by frost, red by lava
Monster deaths: a burst from the body and a wisp of light rising as they fall; elites flare in their colour with a column of light, champions in gold
Bosses rise into the fight, change phase and die in tall columns of light that light up the room
Spells and arrows flash at the hand as they leave it
Spells burst in their own colour where they hit (fire, frost, lightning...), at the monster's body, and fizzle against walls
Novas and shockwaves glow as they spread, with sparks riding the edge; explosions get a fireball
Hits feel stronger: sparks and spray burst from the monster's body instead of its feet, with a bright impact flash (gold on critical hits)
Weapon swings leave a glowing trail that sweeps through the air at weapon height, bright at the front and fading behind
Act 5 monsters are painted: little fire-wyvern Imps, the molten Magma Brute, the crimson Ember Summoner, and the Cinder King, a huge burning skeleton knight
Every act's monsters and bosses now share the painted look (the Vine Lasher keeps its drawn plant)
Act 4 monsters are painted: see-through icy Frost Wraiths, the frost-giant Ice Golem, crystal Shardlings, and Rimeheart, the Frozen King, a crowned skeleton king
Act 3 monsters are painted: mossy Spore Toads, the green Marsh Troll, and the Mother of Rot, a giant queen of the Spore Toads
The Vine Lasher keeps its drawn plant look; Acts 4 and 5 come next
Act 2 monsters are painted: dark Scarab beetles, the robed Dust Mage, the sandy Sandworm that bursts up out of the sand, and the Ash Tyrant, a huge armoured antlion
All painted monsters are a little smaller, to fit the dungeons better
Acts 3 to 5 keep their drawn monsters for now
Act 1 monsters are painted in the same style as your hero: the Ghoul, the Bone Archer, the Minotaur (was the Ogre) and Varrok the Hollow
They run, wind up and strike, shoot, flinch when hit and fall with their own death animation
Settings > Monsters: Painted or Drawn (the other acts' monsters come next)
Your hero now stands large on the Inventory screen, wearing your gear with its colours and glow; every few seconds he shows off his weapon, and a tap turns him around
Painted hero: gear from later acts takes its act's colours (desert sand, marsh moss, frost blue, ember red)
Unique pieces shimmer gold and set pieces shimmer green
The Ranger carries her quiver on her back; the Arcanist's orb or tome floats at his off hand

Painted hero: half the size it was (now a little smaller than the old hero; it was far too big for the world), standing on the right spot, and the running steps now match how far you move instead of a fast blur
New painted hero: detailed art for all three classes with real swing, cast and bow-shot animations, running, getting hit and falling (Settings > Hero: Painted or Drawn)
Your armour shows: robe, leather, chain or plate, plus your helm, gloves, boots and shield type; every weapon type has its own look, with a steel-tipped spear and a heavy crossbow
Spells and arrows now fly at chest height from the hands, not along the floor
The hero pictures download once (about 2 MB for one hero) and then work offline; art from the free game Flare (credits under How to play)
New hero look for the angled camera: a standing figure with legs, body, arms and face, turning 8 ways, walking, breathing and flinching when hit
Weapons are held up at the ready and swing down through a blow; heavy weapons lift overhead first, bows are held upright
Each class has its own build: the broad Warden, the robed Arcanist, the hooded Ranger (armour showing comes next)
Fixed: the game no longer freezes for a moment when you teleport to town
After the game updates itself, a box now shows once with what's new since you last played
New angled camera: you now see the world from an angle instead of straight down, with heroes, monsters and loot standing on the floor
Walls have height and hide what is behind them; walls, houses and props near your hero turn see-through
Props, braziers and town buildings stand upright; switch back any time in Settings › Camera (Angled or Top-down)
The Ranger is complete! Balance: Rain of Arrows and Spike Trap hit much harder, Multishot arrows pierce 1 enemy, Focus refills a little faster
Piercing Shot, Fire Trap and Explosive Arrow are stronger
Every boss now has a matchup for the Ranger (shown under its name), plus Ranger hints and How to play
8 Ranger uniques: one from each act boss (Thornspine Longbow, The Wolfmother's Fang, Quiver of Endless Rain, Stormstring, Heartseeker) and Snaretooth Grips, Falconer's Hood, Galeforce Treads
Ranger set: Trappings of the Wild Hunt (bow, quiver, cloak, boots); the full set makes your wolf and hawk 60% stronger and gives Focus with their hits
Passive tree: the Ranger has his own start at the bottom (➶), with two new branches beside it: Deadeye (crits) and Hunting Pack (wolf and hawk damage)
New keystone below Elemental Ward: Point Blank, more damage up close and less far away (any class can take it)
Ranger paths at level 20 (✨ › Path): 🐺 Beastmaster or 🎯 Sharpshooter, 4 perks each
Beastmaster: stronger, tougher wolf and hawk, free and quicker to call, pet kills heal you
Sharpshooter: +10% crit, more damage at long range, +1 pierce, and every 6th arrow is a triple-damage Headshot
Ranger: 3 modifiers for each of his second skills (15 in all)
Twin Shot, Serrated Shot, Mounting Power · Long Vault, Parting Shot, Spiked Field · Wildfire, Searing Trap, Quick Fuse
Razor Talons, Swift Wings, Hunter's Mark · Short Fuse, Cluster Bomb, Payload
Ranger second skills (swap with ⇄ on the ✨ screen): Piercing Shot, Vault, Fire Trap, Hawk and Explosive Arrow
Vault flips you out of danger and leaves caltrops; Fire Trap leaves burning ground; the Hawk Marks enemies so they take more damage
Their modifiers come in the next update
Ranger: 3 modifiers for each of his 5 skills (15 in all), unlocked at skill rank 3, 6 and 10
Split Arrow, Barbed Arrows, Steady Aim · Volley, Focused Fire, Hunter's Return · Cluster Traps, Lacerating Trap, Hair Trigger
Pack (two wolves), Alpha (one big wolf), Bond · Arrow Storm, Pinning Rain, Downpour
Ranger look and sound: real arrows in flight, a quiver on his back and a pointed hood, his other hand drawing the string
Spike Traps look like iron jaws (red glint once armed) and snap shut; the bow twangs, the wolf howls and bites
Ranger: Call of the Wild, a wolf that follows you, bites your enemies (with your weapon damage) and can be healed by calling it again
Next: the Ranger's own look and sounds
Ranger: Multishot (a fan of 5 arrows), Spike Trap (springs and Stuns when an enemy steps close, up to 3 at once) and Rain of Arrows (volleys over an area)
His wolf (Call of the Wild) comes next
A new class is on its way: the Ranger 🏹. Create one now: bows, crossbows and quivers, built-in evasion and speed, and Arrow Shot
His other skills, his wolf, paths and own items arrive over the next updates
Fixed: in Act 5's fourth zone the waypoint was sometimes missing
Ember gems now work: Wrath, Glacier, Haste, Leech, Bastion, Fortune, Storm and Pyre grow stronger with every level
📖 Book › Embers lists every gem and which of your heroes has it
How to play explains Ember gems
Ember gems: 8 gems that only Ember Rift Guardians drop (about 1 clear in 4); they level up with every Rift you clear in time
Ember slots in the 🎒 bag: the first opens with your first Rift cleared in time, the second at Rift 15
The gems' effects arrive in the next update
The "Tap to start" screen is back in the app and stays until you tap the screen
Fixed: in the app, the "Tap to start" screen no longer flashes up for a moment when the game opens
📖 Book marks every unique and set piece you have found as Ancient (🔸)
Salvaging an Ancient item gives double gold and materials
How to play explains Ancient items
Ancient items: any unique or set item can drop Ancient, with 25% stronger stats, damage and armour (and its +skills round up)
They drop in Hell (1 in 20 uniques), maps (1 in 10) and Ember Rifts (1 in 10, up to 1 in 5 at Rift 20)
Ancient items glow orange and drop with their own burst and sound
The game tells you when a new version of the Android app is out, and downloads it with one tap (app 4 and newer)
☰ menu shows your app version
The game now tells you when an update is ready, with what's new, and updates with one tap
☰ menu: Check for updates and What's new
Blood Magic: the skill screen shows each skill's Life cost
Fixed: the new skills' sparkles could change loot and crit rolls
3 modifiers for each of the 10 new skills (30 in all)
Balance: Seismic Wave, Firewall and Black Hole stronger, Ice Shards a little weaker
Arcanist second skills: Ice Shards, Firewall, Ice Barrier, Storm Orb, Black Hole
Warden second skills: Rending Strike, Charge, Blade Fan, Battle Banner, Seismic Wave
Every skill button can hold a second skill: swap with ⇄ on the ✨ screen
Ember Rifts balance: the same bar on every map, Rift 1 easier, the Guardian quicker to kill
Ember Rifts rewards: better Guardian loot each level, a unique or set item every 5th level, 📖 Book › Rifts
Ember Rifts: endless timed challenges from the Map Device's 🔥 Rift tab (after Hell)
